items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Clarence Williams got me my job in 1916.

ctx.x: You remember Clarence Williams, mister? I said, you remember Clarence Williams? I knew Clarence Williams in New York, yes. And that's Zeno on drums. I've never seen him.
Clarence Williams got the job in 1916. Clarence Williams got me my job in 1916. I gave him $100.
